# Package list of the LOCAL checks environment (`.venv-checks` at the repository root).
#
# Why it exists. The checks and `preflight.py` run on the workstation, not on the
# cluster, before each upload, and no single local interpreter used to be enough:
#   conda 3.13   - has trimesh and pyvista but no cadquery/OCP, and its PyYAML is
#                  the 3.11 one and fails on 3.13 with `collections.Hashable`;
#   /usr/bin/py3 - has PyYAML and nothing else.
# This environment removes the need to split configs and checks between interpreters.
#
# Conditions. Versions are taken FROM `run_env.txt`, the list the run environment
# on the node was built from (python 3.12). Install on `/usr/bin/python3.12`
# (3.12.x is the only line with a `cadquery-ocp==7.7.2` wheel; there is none for 3.13).
#
# WHAT THIS ENVIRONMENT IS NOT.
#
# 1. It is not the run environment. There is no vLLM, torch or CUDA: models are
#    not served locally, and everything that needs them is stubbed in the checks.
#    No run numbers are measured in this environment.
# 2. IoU is computed locally, but its cost is not the server's, so draw no
#    conclusions from local timings.
# 3. `_cad_grad` is not pip-installable (it is tied to the interpreter ABI).
#    Without it the optimizer is silently off, and preflight warns about it.
#    Build for this interpreter:
#    `./agent/tools/build_cad_grad.sh .venv-checks/bin/python`.
#
# Built and verified by `agent/env/build_check_env.sh` (`--check` only verifies).
# Verify the OUTCOME, not legality: after the build run `agent/run_tests.sh` and
# `agent/tools/preflight.py`.

# --- configs ------------------------------------------------------------------
pyyaml==6.0.3

# --- numerics --------------------------------------------------------------------
numpy==2.2.6
scipy==1.17.1

# --- DSL execution -----------------------------------------------------------
cadquery-ocp==7.7.2
cadquery==2.5.2

# --- meshes and metrics -----------------------------------------------------------
trimesh==4.12.2
manifold3d==3.5.0
embreex==4.4.0
networkx==3.6.1
shapely==2.1.2
rtree==1.4.1
pillow==12.2.0
pykdtree==1.4.3
point-cloud-utils==0.34.0

# --- view rendering -------------------------------------------------------------
pyvista==0.46.3
vtk==9.4.2

# --- model client -----------------------------------------------------------
# Installed although no models run locally: the client is imported on the way to
# the config check, and its absence would turn an import failure into a config failure.
openai==2.24.0

# --- misc -------------------------------------------------------------------
tqdm==4.67.3
